trip.name: Family Paris Trip
trip.description: Seven days exploring the magic of Paris — art, food, history, and unforgettable family memories!

itinerary.title: Arrival & Settling In
itinerary.notes: Land at CDG at 10:00 AM. Take RER B train to city center (~40 min). Check into hotel. Rest, explore the neighborhood, dinner at a local bistro.

itinerary.title: Iconic Paris
itinerary.notes: Morning at the Eiffel Tower — book tickets in advance! Afternoon Seine River Cruise. Evening photos from Trocadéro.

itinerary.title: Art & Culture
itinerary.notes: Full day at the Louvre. Focus on highlights: Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, Winged Victory. Nearby Jardin des Tuileries for a picnic break.

itinerary.title: Montmartre & Versailles
itinerary.notes: Morning hike up Montmartre, visit Sacré-Cœur Basilica, browse artist studios. Afternoon: Palace of Versailles day trip (~1h by RER C).

itinerary.title: Notre-Dame & Impressionists
itinerary.notes: Visit the rebuilt Notre-Dame Cathedral. Walk along Île de la Cité and Île Saint-Louis. Afternoon at Musée d'Orsay.

itinerary.title: Shopping & Le Marais
itinerary.notes: Morning in Le Marais — boutiques, falafel at L'As du Fallafel. Afternoon shopping at Galeries Lafayette. Evening farewell dinner cruise.

itinerary.title: Departure Day
itinerary.notes: Check out by 11:00 AM. Light morning stroll in Luxembourg Gardens. Private transfer to CDG for afternoon flight home.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.description: Paris's iconic iron lattice tower offering breathtaking city views. Built 1887–1889 for the World's Fair. Book summit tickets well in advance.
attractions.address: Champ de Mars, 5 Av. Anatole France, 75007 Paris

attractions.name: The Louvre
attractions.description: World's largest art museum with over 35,000 works including the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo. Allow a full day.

attractions.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
attractions.description: Magnificent Gothic cathedral on Île de la Cité, recently reopened after the 2019 fire. Free entry, timed reservations recommended.
attractions.address: 6 Parvis Notre-Dame - Pl. Jean-Paul II, 75004 Paris

attractions.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica
attractions.description: White domed basilica perched atop Montmartre hill with panoramic views over all of Paris. Free entry.
attractions.address: 35 Rue du Chevalier de la Barre, 75018 Paris

attractions.name: Palace of Versailles
attractions.description: Opulent royal château 20km from Paris. Explore the Hall of Mirrors and the stunning formal gardens. Book online.

attractions.name: Musée d'Orsay
attractions.description: World's largest collection of Impressionist art, housed in a gorgeous converted 19th-century railway station.
attractions.address: 1 Rue de la Légion d'Honneur, 75007 Paris

attractions.name: Seine River Cruise
attractions.description: Bateaux Mouches boat tour along the Seine — see Paris's landmarks from the water in about 1 hour.
attractions.address: Port de la Conférence, Pont de l'Alma, 75008 Paris

attractions.name: Champs-Élysées
attractions.description: Paris's most famous avenue lined with shops, cafés, theaters, and iconic views of the Arc de Triomphe.

attractions.name: Arc de Triomphe
attractions.description: Monumental arch honoring those who fought for France, with a rooftop terrace and aerial views over 12 avenues.

attractions.name: Le Marais District
attractions.description: Historic neighborhood with medieval architecture, art galleries, trendy boutiques, and the best falafel in Paris.

attractions.name: Jardin des Tuileries
attractions.description: Grand public garden between the Louvre and Place de la Concorde. Perfect for a picnic break and relaxing stroll.

attractions.name: Luxembourg Gardens
attractions.description: Beautiful formal gardens in the Latin Quarter — peaceful morning spot perfect before heading to the airport.

attractions.name: Galeries Lafayette
attractions.description: Paris's most famous department store with a stunning Art Nouveau glass dome. Hundreds of brands on 8 floors.

restaurants.name: Nobu Malibu
restaurants.description: World-famous Japanese-Peruvian fusion on the Malibu coast. Known for black cod miso and fresh sashimi.

restaurants.name: Bestia
restaurants.description: Bustling Italian-inspired spot in the Arts District. Exceptional house-made pasta, pizzas, and charcuterie.

restaurants.name: Guelaguetza
restaurants.description: LA's beloved Oaxacan restaurant. Try the mole negro, tlayudas, and mezcal cocktails.
restaurants.address: 3014 W Olympic Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90006

restaurants.name: In-N-Out Burger
restaurants.description: The classic California burger experience. Order Animal Style — you'll thank us later.
